title: Creating Opportunities for Teaching, Training & Consultation as an Aspiring Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组头脑风暴大师课、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南-梅森礼品以及限时一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast, that's your side.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客，这就是你的坚强后盾。

sentences.en: You'll be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 你将迈向有抱负的心理学家播客。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: I, as ever, am Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 和往常一样，我是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Let's think today about opportunities for you to do teaching as an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 今天我们来思考一下，作为一名有抱负的心理学家，你可以有哪些教学机会。

sentences.en: Of course, it can be one of the really useful core competencies to demonstrate your readiness.
sentences.zh: 当然，这可以作为证明你已准备就绪的非常实用的核心能力之一。

sentences.en: For becoming either a trainee, clinical psychologist, or other types of psychologist too.
sentences.zh: 无论是为了成为实习临床心理学家，还是其他类型的心理学家。

sentences.en: It's really helpful if you're able to demonstrate that you've had experience of teaching information to others.
sentences.zh: 如果你能证明自己有过向他人传授信息的经验，那将非常有帮助。

sentences.en: It might look like actual teaching.
sentences.zh: 这看起来可能就像真正的教学。

sentences.en: Perhaps you've done English as a foreign language stuff.
sentences.zh: 也许你做过把英语作为外语教学的相关内容。

sentences.en: Maybe you've had time in Japan or something teaching English.
sentences.zh: 也许你在日本等地呆过一段时间，教过英语。

sentences.en: Maybe you've done Camp America type stuff and done mentoring and sort of leadership and nurturing and childcare.
sentences.zh: 也许你做过美国夏令营之类的事情，做过指导、领导、培育和儿童保育工作。

sentences.en: Or maybe, actually, you're retraining and you've been a teacher, teacher, before.
sentences.zh: 或者实际上，你可能正在重新接受培训，以前就是一名名副其实的老师。

sentences.en: It might be like me.
sentences.zh: 这可能就像我一样。

sentences.en: My teaching experience, when I got onto clinical training, had been from doing training within the private hospital that I worked in.
sentences.zh: 我进入临床培训时的教学经验，来自于在我工作过的私立医院内部进行的培训。

sentences.en: I was in a forensic service and I mentioned in a previous podcast episode that one of my responsibilities was doing behavioural observations for a specific tool,
sentences.zh: 我曾在法医服务部门工作，我在之前的播客节目中提到过，我的职责之一是针对一个特定工具进行行为观察，

sentences.en: which we called the Modified Avert Aggression Scale.
sentences.zh: 我们称之为修改版突发攻击量表。

sentences.en: It was a little fiddly and the idea was that actually, in order for it to be valid and for the data to count, that everyone really needed to be using the tool in the same way.
sentences.zh: 这个工具操作起来有点繁琐，其理念是，为了使其有效且数据计入成绩，每个人确实都需要以相同的方式使用该工具。

sentences.en: We were needing to make sure that they were interpreting it in the same way.
sentences.zh: 我们需要确保他们对它的解读是一致的。

sentences.en: So the levels of aggression or violence or anger.
sentences.zh: 也就是攻击、暴力或愤怒的程度。

sentences.en: And I seem to recall that if someone had been really, really angry, you know, kind of ended up breaking someone's leg, for example,
sentences.zh: 我记得如果有人真的非常非常生气，你知道的，最后导致把别人的腿给折断了，比如说，

sentences.en: which would obviously be extreme, you know, the most extreme sort of score that you could get,
sentences.zh: 这显然是极端的，你知道的，你能得到的最高分数的极端情况，

sentences.en: that you want them to obviously report it in a certain way.
sentences.zh: 你会希望他们显然以某种特定方式上报。

sentences.en: But if someone, for example, had kicked a chair, then that would be less extreme.
sentences.zh: 但如果有人，例如，踢了一把椅子，那么这就不那么极端。

sentences.en: So we needed to make sure that people were recording consistently, if that makes sense.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要确保人们的记录保持一致，如果这说得通的话。

sentences.en: Because it was a bit fiddly, it was important that we were communicating to the unit staff how we needed that to be done.
sentences.zh: 因为这个工具有点繁琐，所以向病房工作人员传达我们如何需要他们完成这项工作就很重要。

sentences.en: We would do that at the induction, which happened when people joined the hospital.
sentences.zh: 我们会在入职培训时这样做，入职培训是人们加入医院时进行的。

sentences.en: But also, if you work for a private hospital or you work for any large organisation, you will likely be oh so familiar with refresher yearly training.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果你在私立医院工作，或者在任何大型组织工作，你可能对每年一次的复习培训无比熟悉。

sentences.en: We decided that actually it wasn't great use of the qualified psychologist's time to be doing all this training.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，让合格的心理学家花时间做所有这些培训并不是很好的利用方式。

sentences.en: Because actually, it was predictable.
sentences.zh: 因为实际上，这是可以预测的。

sentences.en: Absolutely, the psychologist had a hand in designing the training and supporting us with that.
sentences.zh: 当然，心理学家参与了培训的设计并为我们提供了支持。

sentences.en: We decided that actually, yes, our time would be well placed and it would be good for our experience
sentences.zh: 我们认为，是的，我们的时间会被妥善利用，这对于我们的经验很有好处，

sentences.en: and for our developing relationships with people in the hospital, in our units, to do that training ourselves.
sentences.zh: 并且对于我们在医院、在我们病区与人们建立不断发展的关系，自己去做那个培训也很有好处。

sentences.en: It was in a training venue in the hospital and it was quite a formal situation to sort of 20, 30 people at a time.
sentences.zh: 那是在医院的一个培训场地，对一次大约20到30人来说是一个相当正式的场合。

sentences.en: But it gave me and my colleague the opportunity to be able to tick teaching off on our competences for the big form.
sentences.zh: 但这给我和我的同事提供了一个机会，可以在我们大表格的能力项上勾选教学这一项。

sentences.en: It might be useful for you to think about whether there's anything that you're doing in your day-to-day job
sentences.zh: 思考一下你在日常工作中是否有任何事情可以帮助他人提升技能，可能会对你有所帮助，

sentences.en: that you could help upskill others on, either as a repeatable, predictable thing,
sentences.zh: 无论是作为一项可重复、可预测的事情，

sentences.en: or maybe you could do some sort of consultation or some sort of formulation session for people regularly,
sentences.zh: 或者也许你可以定期为人们做某种咨询或某种构思会话，

sentences.en: or actually, you know, teaching them some skills in some nice, maybe some nice soothing breathing that then they might be able to teach their clients.
sentences.zh: 或者实际上，你知道的，教他们一些技能，比如做一些很好的、也许能舒缓压力的呼吸，然后他们也许就能教给他们的来访者。

sentences.en: Could you maybe pick some strategies that you currently use and help teach them to the staff that you work with?
sentences.zh: 你能不能挑选一些你目前使用的策略，并帮助把它们教给你共事的员工？

sentences.en: Or maybe you've got the opportunity to run a group.
sentences.zh: 或者也许你有机会运营一个小组。

sentences.en: When I was in my assistant's role, I ran a group for old adults who had dementia diagnosis and we implemented the cognitive stimulation therapy group, which was fully lovely.
sentences.zh: 当我担任助理时，我为一个诊断为痴呆症的老年人运营了一个小组，我们实施了认知刺激疗法小组，这非常棒。

sentences.en: But there's teaching elements in that as well, of course.
sentences.zh: 当然，其中也有教学成分。

sentences.en: Groups are, of course, a great experience for you as an aspiring psychologist and great experience for you as a qualified psychologist too.
sentences.zh: 对于身为有抱负的心理学家的你来说，小组当然是一段极好的经历，对于身为合格心理学家的你来说也是极好的经历。

sentences.en: It's just useful thinking about actually if there's a protocol or a manual or some book or approach that you really like and you think would really resonate with your clients,
sentences.zh: 思考一下实际上是否有一套规程、手册、某本书或某种你真的很喜欢并且认为会真正引起你来访者共鸣的方法，这会很有用，

sentences.en: then it can be worth thinking through in your supervision about whether that's something you could use and to bring to the service and to teach others about.
sentences.zh: 那么在你的督导中思考这是否是你可以使用并带到服务中去教给别人的东西，是值得的。

sentences.en: So don't be afraid to ask and to think outside the box and to think actually about the benefits of what you are offering to your service.
sentences.zh: 所以不要害怕去询问，去打破常规思考，去实际思考你为服务所提供内容的益处。

sentences.en: But you are allowed to benefit too.
sentences.zh: 但你也有权从中受益。

sentences.en: Actually, I think the pandemic certainly caused the NHS to modernise by about 20 years within the space of about a year.
sentences.zh: 实际上，我认为这场大流行确实在一年之内促使英国国家医疗服务体系现代化了大约20年。

sentences.en: It meant that we were able to bring online more flexible ways of working, which meant that I was able to host Zoom groups.
sentences.zh: 这意味着我们能够在线引入更灵活的工作方式，这意味着我能够主持Zoom小组。

sentences.en: And actually, had I stayed in the NHS, it was my plan to create a waiting list group where people could come along monthly and do stabilisation work with me.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果我留在英国国家医疗服务体系，我的计划是创建一个候诊名单小组，人们可以每月来一次，和我一起做稳定化工作。

sentences.en: There was no need to book anyone who was either male or female on the separate list, depending on which week it was, who was on the waiting list for psychology,
sentences.zh: 不需要把任何男性或女性安排在单独的名单上预约，这取决于具体是哪一周，谁在心理学候诊名单上，

sentences.en: would be able to come along via Zoom at this set time on a set date and come along if they were free and if they wanted to do stabilisation work as a standalone session.
sentences.zh: 都能够在设定的日期和固定时间通过Zoom前来，如果他们有空，并且想作为独立会话来做稳定化工作的话。

sentences.en: And I would have been really super excited to do that.
sentences.zh: 我会为此感到超级兴奋。

sentences.en: So maybe if that's something you think your service could benefit from, then you could run that with a qualified psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这是你认为你的服务能从中受益的事情，那么你可以和一个合格的心理学家一起运营它。

sentences.en: Or if you actually feel like you have the skills and experience to be able to do that yourself
sentences.zh: 或者如果你真的觉得自己有能力和经验能够自己做到这一点，

sentences.en: with the assistance of a more junior member, perhaps, or someone else too in your team, because it's useful to run groups in twos just to help with things you might miss,
sentences.zh: 也许在团队中更资浅的成员或另一个人的协助下，因为成对运行小组很有用，只是为了帮助处理你可能遗漏的事情，

sentences.en: especially when it's via Zoom, because you can't have eyes everywhere.
sentences.zh: 特别是当它通过Zoom进行时，因为你不可能眼观六路。

sentences.en: But could that be an opportunity for you to do some teaching and, you know, some sort of group work?
sentences.zh: 但这会不会成为你进行一些教学，你知道的，某种小组工作的机会呢？

sentences.en: So there's absolutely a crossover between teaching, training and group work because you need to make sure that your style is such that people can engage with what you're saying.
sentences.zh: 所以教学、培训和小组工作之间绝对有交叉，因为你需要确保你的风格能够让人们参与到你所说的话中。

sentences.en: Stick around and I will be right back after this quick advert.
sentences.zh: 请稍候，看完这个简短的广告后我马上回来。

sentences.en: Hi, my name is Beth and I'm a psychological well-being practitioner from Newcastle.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我叫贝丝，我是来自纽卡斯尔的一名心理健康从业者。

sentences.en: I just wanted to say the biggest thank you to the contributors of the Clinical Psychologist Collective Group.
sentences.zh: 我只想对临床心理学家集体小组的贡献者们表示最诚挚的感谢。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed reading this so much and loved having an insight into the range of backgrounds and experiences people have prior to applying for the doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我非常享受阅读这些内容，并且很喜欢深入了解人们在申请博士学位之前所拥有的各种背景和经历。

sentences.en: And it's been really interesting seeing the potential barriers to the application as well and how I can try and work around this.
sentences.zh: 而且看到申请的潜在障碍以及我如何尝试绕过这些障碍也非常有趣。

sentences.en: I really started to doubt myself and whether I was good enough to apply for the Clinical Psychology Doctorate.
sentences.zh: 我真的开始怀疑自己，怀疑自己是否足够优秀去申请临床心理学博士。

sentences.en: But this has really given me the confidence boost that I needed to give it a shot.
sentences.zh: 但这确实给了我放手一试所需的信心提振。

sentences.en: So the biggest thank you ever.
sentences.zh: 所以要致以最深切的谢意。

sentences.en: Is it just me who ends up singing those jingles in the shower when I'm chopping food?
sentences.zh: 只有我一个人在洗澡或切菜时会不由自主地唱起那些广告歌吗？

sentences.en: I just love them.
sentences.zh: 我太喜欢它们了。

sentences.en: So it can be useful to think about the ways that you can tap into teaching too.
sentences.zh: 所以思考如何利用教学途径也会很有用。

sentences.en: When I was on the doctorate, sometimes we had people who are like local assistant psychologists coming along to some of our teaching sessions.
sentences.zh: 当我读博士时，有时我们会遇到一些当地的助理心理学家来参加我们的一些教学课程。

sentences.en: And I recall that happening at least on a couple of occasions.
sentences.zh: 我记得这种情况至少发生过好几次。

sentences.en: So it might be worth you making contact with your local course and asking if any of the teaching sessions are kind of more open forum.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能值得联系你当地的课程负责人，询问是否有任何教学课程是那种更加开放的论坛形式。

sentences.en: Because that certainly was the case when I was there.
sentences.zh: 因为我在那里的时候确实就是这样的。

sentences.en: It was the specialist teaching modules in the third year.
sentences.zh: 那是第三年的专业教学模块。

sentences.en: And if they were undersubscribed, and where I was, there was like two different universities that you could opt into the Friday teaching in year three.
sentences.zh: 如果他们的人数不足，而在我所在的地方，有两所不同的大学，你可以在第三年选择加入周五的教学。

sentences.en: But it meant that sometimes there was just, you know, a few people on the course on that day.
sentences.zh: 但这意味着有时那天课程上真的只有，你知道的，区区几个人。

sentences.en: And they might have loads of empty spaces.
sentences.zh: 而且他们可能会有大量的空位。

sentences.en: It makes sense for people to benefit from those.
sentences.zh: 让人们从这些空位中受益是合乎情理的。

sentences.en: So it might be that there's a similar option for you in your local area.
sentences.zh: 所以你当地可能也有类似的选项供你选择。

sentences.en: And then you can get your experience really up to date, really useful teaching and see how it's done.
sentences.zh: 然后你可以让你的经验真正跟上时代，获得非常实用的教学并看看它是如何完成的。

sentences.en: And think about whether you might be able to do some teaching, some training or some consultation.
sentences.zh: 并考虑你是否可以进行一些教学、一些培训或一些咨询。

sentences.en: So I hope you found that useful.
sentences.zh: 所以我希望你觉得这很有用。

sentences.en: Just don't be afraid to think outside the box.
sentences.zh: 千万不要害怕打破常规去思考。

sentences.en: If you think this might be useful for you to thicken up this particular competency, then could you, you know, decide to take this on?
sentences.zh: 如果你认为这对你巩固这一特定能力有用，那么你能不能，你知道的，决定承担起这个任务？

sentences.en: Maybe you could think about, you know, reading a particular book.
sentences.zh: 也许你可以考虑，你知道的，阅读某本特定的书。

sentences.en: Maybe that your whole department might not have time to read.
sentences.zh: 也许你的整个部门可能都没有时间去阅读。

sentences.en: And then like do a little digest for them or a research paper or go along to some training event on behalf of your department and then teach it to them.
sentences.zh: 然后为他们做一个小文摘或研究论文，或者代表你的部门参加一些培训活动，然后教给他们。

sentences.en: Disseminate the pertinent points in a much shorter period of time.
sentences.zh: 在短得多的时间内传播相关的要点。

sentences.en: And you could get a bit, you know, whizzy here on your PowerPoint or your Canva, whatever floats your boat.
sentences.zh: 而且你可以在你的PPT或Canva上变得，你知道的，花哨一点，随你喜欢。

sentences.en: But could you demonstrate that you have the ability to teach to, you know, to do what we call comprehension and sort of comprehend what's been said
sentences.zh: 但你能不能证明你具备教学能力，你知道的，做我们所说理解力的事情，并且理解所说的话，

sentences.en: and put it across then to others in a way that helps them in a meaningful way.
sentences.zh: 然后以一种对他们有意义的方式帮助他们，将其实际表达给其他人。

sentences.en: I think this flexibility and this thinking outside the box-ness is one of the things that we're particularly good at in the psychology field.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种灵活性和这种打破常规的思维方式是我们心理学领域特别擅长的方面之一。

sentences.en: And for you really to start building and thickening those competencies for your own career as an aspiring psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 为了让你真正开始为自己作为有抱负的心理学家的职业生涯建立和巩固这些能力。

sentences.en: And it might well just be the type of thing that you can use if only to develop your own confidence
sentences.zh: 这很可能就是你可以利用的那种事情，哪怕只是为了培养你自己的自信，

sentences.en: before then going on to do something a little bit more formal in terms of teaching.
sentences.zh: 然后再去进行一些更正式的教学活动。

sentences.en: And if you've done your psychology undergrad thesis, perhaps you could present that to your department if there's any useful learning points there for them too.
sentences.zh: 如果你做过心理学本科毕业论文，如果其中对他们有任何有用的学习要点，也许你可以向你的部门展示它。

sentences.en: It's about thinking about creating those opportunities.
sentences.zh: 关键在于思考如何创造这些机会。

sentences.en: Why did I just say creating so weirdly?
sentences.zh: 我刚才为什么把“创造”这个词说得那么奇怪？

sentences.en: Sorry about that one.
sentences.zh: 那次真是抱歉。

sentences.en: If actually you recognise that there's a lot of skills and talents in your department, then could you maybe put together a monthly programme where you all teach each other?
sentences.zh: 如果你实际上意识到你的部门里有很多技能和才华，那么你是否可以组织一个每月的项目，让你们互相教对方？

sentences.en: You could perhaps be the lead, you could hold it together, head it up, and you might maybe do more spaces in the year than other people because it's your baby.
sentences.zh: 你也许可以担任负责人，你可以把它整合起来，挑头领导，而且你可能比其他人做更多月份的活动，因为这是你的心血结晶。

sentences.en: And yeah, I hope you have some fun with this and that you find it helpful.
sentences.zh: 是的，我希望你能从中获得一些乐趣，并发现它对你有所帮助。

sentences.en: If you've got any other ideas for how you can cram some teaching, training and consultation into your work, then do give me a shout.
sentences.zh: 如果你对如何在工作中塞进一些教学、培训和咨询有任何其他想法，请务必告诉我。

sentences.en: And I'd really be happy to expand on this further.
sentences.zh: 我真的很高兴能对此作进一步的详细说明。

sentences.en: I hope you find it useful.
sentences.zh: 我希望你觉得它有用。

sentences.en: And if you do, please leave me a review, rate it and of course, subscribe.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得有用，请给我留个评价、打个分，当然，还要订阅。

sentences.en: Take care and I'll catch up with you very soon.
sentences.zh: 保重，我们很快再聊。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast, let's your side.
sentences.zh: 有了这个播客，作为你的坚强后盾。

sentences.en: You'll be on your way to being qualified.
sentences.zh: 你将迈向获得资质的道路。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 这就是《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: With Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 主讲人是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个激动人心的好消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's one-to-many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·福特的“一对多”项目现在已经开放报名了。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己于2022年完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两届心理学家走过他们的成长历程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 其中包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四个小组头脑风暴大师课、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南-梅森礼品以及限时一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 请通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
